dict.string: 3PO reads your agenda and manages events you explicitly ask it to create or edit.
3PO reads your agenda and manages events you explicitly ask it to create or edit.
3PO shows your reminders, completes them with Undo, and manages reminders you explicitly request.
3PO reads inbox messages from Apple Mail for your local dashboard. It never sends email.
3PO uses your microphone only when you start dictation, to prepare an editable message.
3PO transcribes your dictated message on device so you can review it before sending.
3PO uses your location for a local forecast. It sends only a rounded nearby area to Open-Meteo; your PA receives weather, never coordinates.
